column1: # *** THE FULL-TEXT SWEEP OF 15 SEPTEMBER 2026, AND A FILM NUMBER THIS ARCHIVE DID NOT HAVE. ***
# FamilySearch full text, keyword "Sancho Llerena", 68 results.
# *** Error 15 returned mid-session. One zero-result extraction was a BLOCKED PAGE and is not a null. ***
*** THE FULL-TEXT SWEEP FOR 'SANCHO LLERENA', 15 September 2026 ***
column2: *** 68 results. *** The archive's earlier sweeps of this phrase were run when the index was smaller and returned far fewer. *** The search page worked; the ark/image pages were blocked by Error 15 minutes later, and one extraction returned zero links purely because the page behind it was the block notice. That zero is NOT recorded as a null. ***
column4: *** FULL TEXT IS NOW THE RIGHT INSTRUMENT FOR THIS FAMILY, AND IMAGE-WALKING IS THE FALLBACK. *** It found in seconds the thing this session was about to look for by reading three hundred images by hand.

column1: *** A FILM THIS ARCHIVE HAD NEVER NAMED: DGS 7713375 ***
column2: *** The 1789 godparent act is dgs:007713375.007713375_00551. The 1811 baptism of Luis - already the archive's best document on Sancho's parents - is dgs:007713375.007713375_02410. *** Both resolved from their arks through the tile service's manifest while www was blocked.
column4: *** THE MONTEVIDEO CATHEDRAL BAPTISMS ARE ON DGS 7713375, AND THE ARCHIVE NOW HAS IMAGE NUMBERS FOR TWO KNOWN ACTS. *** The film runs at least from 1785 (image 551) to 1811 (image 2410). *** This is NOT the film the archive has been calling the castrense books. *** That is DGS 7713373, and the regiment kept its own separate register - so the Cathedral book and the regiment book are two different books, both filmed, and Sancho is so far in the first and not the second.

column1: *** WHERE 'SANCHO LLERENA' ACTUALLY APPEARS, BY COLLECTION ***
column2: From the results list as displayed: *** Canelones - Baptism Records 1794-1810; Confirmation Records 1804; Religious Marriage Investigation Files 1776-1806 ***. *** Montevideo - Catedral de la Inmaculada Concepcion (Ciudad Vieja) Baptism Records 1785-1791, 1810-1811 and 1825-1828; Nuestra Senora del Carmen, Cordon, Baptism Records 1828-1836 and Religious Marriage Records 1825-1916 ***.
column4: *** TWO OF THESE ARE NEW TO THIS ARCHIVE AND UNREAD: the Cathedral's Baptism Records 1825-1828, and the Cordon Religious Marriage Records 1825-1916. *** The rest correspond to acts already held. *** The snippet for the 1789 hit reads '...Ciudad. Padrinos Sancho Llerena, y ...', YEARS: 1789 *** - which is the godparent act the archive already had, now pinned to a film and image.

column1: *** AND WHAT IS NOT IN THE LIST - THE POINT THAT MATTERS ***
column2: *** No military or castrense collection appears among the hits. *** The regiment's own book - read directly this session at DGS 7713373, images 652-950 - is not represented.
column4: *** THIS IS NOT YET EVIDENCE OF ABSENCE, AND MUST NOT BE USED AS ANY. *** A name can be missing from full text because it is not in the book, or because *** the book is not in the full-text index at all ***. *** THE CONTROL THAT DECIDES IT: search a phrase known to be in that book *** - *** 'Capellan del Regimiento Infanteria de Buenos Ayres', or the chaplain's name BERROETA ***. If that returns hits from the castrense collection, the book is indexed and Sancho's absence from it is a real finding. If it returns nothing, the book is unindexed and *** the only way to answer the question is to read the three hundred images by hand. *** Until that control is run, nothing is concluded.

column1: *** THE BERROETA CONTROL WAS RUN, AND IT PASSED ***
column2: *** Keyword 'Capellan del Regimiento Infanteria de Buenos Ayres' returns 22 results. *** They come from a collection titled *** 'Montevideo. Military Award Records 1812-1814' ***, with snippets reading *** '...de Berroeta Capellan del Regimiento ...' *** and YEARS lines carrying *** 1789, 1790, 1791 and 1792 *** - the chaplain and the exact years of the book read by hand this session.
column4: *** THE REGIMENT'S CHAPLAINCY BOOK IS IN THE FULL-TEXT INDEX. *** That was the whole point of the control: it means *** the absence of any military collection from the 68 results for 'Sancho Llerena' is EVIDENCE, not merely a gap in coverage. *** *** AND IT PROBABLY RETIRES A DAY OF WORK *** - the plan to read images 663-950 by hand existed only because this was unknown.

column1: *** TWO LIMITS ON THAT, BOTH REAL ***
column2: *** FIRST: the hits have NOT been traced back to DGS 7713373. *** The collection is labelled 1812-1814 while its snippets carry 1789-1792, so the label is unreliable, and *** nobody has yet opened one of the 22 and resolved its ark to a film number. *** Until that is done it is inference, not identification. *** SECOND: the variant sweeps were not finished. *** 'Sancho Lerena' and 'Sancho Lorena' were not run - Error 15 returned after the control and before them.
column4: *** SO THE HONEST STATEMENT IS: the book is indexed, and Sancho is not in it under the spelling 'Sancho Llerena'. *** Not yet: that he is absent from it altogether. *** Machine transcription of eighteenth-century hands is imperfect, so an index absence is weaker than a page absence *** - which is why the eleven images read by hand still matter.
